title: The boss, the story, the score
notes: A new boss fight: when you light the sky, the source descends. Tap on the pulse to break your tower down, and when its great eye opens, be still.
The story now comes in chapters, each paragraph over its own living painting. Chapter I opens when Hearth is relit.
New music: composed pieces that shuffle and crossfade, with their own themes for the title and the boss.
The Dark is painted: a heaving sea of ink and ash that swallows what falls.
